column1: # ESP-IDF Partition Table -- factory-less OTA layout for the 16MB flash on the
# ESP32-P4-ETH: otadata picks which of the two equal app slots boots
# `idf.py flash` writes ota_0 and each OTA update (espp ota module / web
# console) alternates to the other slot. The `coredump` partition holds the
# panic core dump that the espp coredump module serves to the web console.
